unit_goal_source:
docs/backlog/runtime-js/worker-threads-handle-keepalive.md @ ef3da9c95855540a3c8f1d8a685e946cc19b5541; BASE 63414c693. Fresh independent reviewer /root/worker_contract_review. Raw handoff: «Поставь цель реализовать эпик vitest-run-in-browser
Результат принеси одним зеленым ПРом». Read goal.md, map.md, predecessor drafts, ADR-0152, source fixtures and raw reference evidence. RDY-6: merge preserves I2/I5 and exact-pair/both-pools/TS scope; no new user policy or narrowing; node -e parent is an execArgv discrimination carrier, not expanded Worker eval support. REV-5: live Node v24.16.0 all 11 cases exit 0 with recorded output; RIFTY_PLAYGROUND_PORT=5402 pnpm test:browser-unit tests/browser-unit/worker-thread-lifecycle.spec.ts gives 9 expected behavioral RED and 2 controls PASS (39.3s), /tmp/rifty-worker-review-red.log. Missing parent liveness gives absent message/exit, child natural/port cases timeout after expected message, stdio absent, explicit [] throws named ceiling. No new Worker implementation in reviewed diff. Stream EOF and exit both settle; no EOF-before-exit claim. Subsequent unrelated acceptance edits excluded.
merge_call: Contract+RED accepted with advisory duplicate-exit coverage weakness; continue implementation, then independent Final+GREEN. Not a product merge approval.

findings.summary: terminate-releases-once cannot observe duplicate exit events because the only committed observer uses once('exit'). An executed duplicate-exit probe keeps its exact expected rows. Consider a persistent exit counter.
findings.evidence: node --import tsx /tmp/rifty-worker-duplicate-probe.mjs (Node v24.16.0): PROBE|exit-count=2; committed-comparison-equal=true; code=0, stdout WORKER rows identical. Probe wraps native Worker.emit so its real exit emits twice before native cleanup. Full source /tmp/rifty-worker-duplicate-probe.mjs, output /tmp/rifty-worker-duplicate-probe.log.
